year_selection_basis: Data availability/product compatibility only; never test performance
main_estimand: Equal-window mean of within-seed paired percentage gains; fixed three-seed mean within each window
other_contrasts: All seven predeclared P3b comparisons retained; source contrasts exploratory

date_blocks.aggregate: Independent date draws per window, shared across models and seeds within each window; equal-window mean
date_blocks.uncertainty: Window-conditional weather-date variation across fixed fitted models; no seed resampling

freeze_gates: Candidate year untouched by model-error analysis
Complete matching 10m analysis product and 3h timestamps
Same target/neighborhood mapping and native grid
Finite nonnegative extracted speed and feature order
Training-only preprocessors and validation-only early stopping
Final selected year, windows, sources, code and metrics bound before first model fitting or test-score access
failure_policy: Retry infrastructure failures with identical inputs/seed; no dropping bad-performing runs, dates, groups or windows. Data mismatch invalidates freeze and requires a new version before results.
nonclaims: Reanalysis targets, not independent observed turbine wind
